documents.title: Genomic language model for predicting enhancers and their allele-specific activity in the human genome.
meta: Sathian, R; Dutta, P; Ay, F; Davuluri, R V
documents.summary: 该文用DNABERT基因组语言模型预测人类增强子及其等位基因活性，属于染色质水平顺式调控元件预测，但未涉及三维空间结构建模，方法可迁移但对象非三维基因组。
documents.abstract: MOTIVATION: Predicting and deciphering the regulatory logic of enhancers remains a significant challenge due to their complex sequence features and the absence of consistent genetic or epigenetic signatures that distinguish them from other genomic regions. Existing machine learning methods capture nucleotide composition but often fail to model sequence context effectively. RESULTS: We present DNABERT-Enhancer, a novel enhancer prediction method, by applying DNABERT pre-trained language model on the human genome. Using ENCODE registry of candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs), we curated a benchmark dataset, consisting of 21,926 enhancers of 201 bp length and 46,159 enhancers of 350 bp length, as positive instances. The best fine-tuned model achieved 88.05% accuracy and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 76% on an independent dataset. Genome-wide application identified 1,684,595 enhancer regions covering 26.65% of the human genome. By performing integrative analyses with DNABERT-based transcription factor models, we identify 2,681 statistically significant loss-of-function and 1,917 gain-of-function enhancer variants, which respectively alter the function of 1,623 and 1,247 ENCODE-cCRE enhancers. Similarly, we identify 4,057 candidate de novo enhancers, created by 5,464 gain-of-function variants. These genome-wide enhancer annotations and candidate genetic variants predicted by DNABERT-Enhancer provide valuable resources for genome interpretation in functional and clinical genomics studies. AVAILABILITY: DNABERT-Enhancer is freely available at https://github.com/DavuluriLab/DNABERT-Enhancer; Trained model predictions can be explored interactively via the web application at https://dnabert-enhancer-datarepo.streamlit.app/. The fine-tuned models are archived and citable through Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19157566). SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online. 动机：由于增强子（enhancer）复杂的序列特征以及缺乏一致的遗传或表观遗传标记将其与其他基因组区域区分开来，预测和解读增强子的调控逻辑仍然是一项重大挑战。现有的机器学习方法能够捕获核苷酸组成，但通常无法有效建模序列上下文。结果：我们提出了DNABERT-Enhancer，一种新颖的增强子预测方法，通过将DNABERT预训练语言模型应用于人类基因组。利用ENCODE候选顺式调控元件（cCRE）注册表，我们整理了一个基准数据集，包含21,926个长度为201 bp的增强子和46,159个长度为350 bp的增强子作为正例。最佳微调模型在独立数据集上达到了88.05%的准确率和76%的马修斯相关系数（Matthews correlation coefficient）。全基因组应用识别出1,684,595个增强子区域，覆盖人类基因组的26.65%。通过与基于DNABERT的转录因子模型进行整合分析，我们识别出2,681个统计显著的功能丧失型（loss-of-function）和1,917个功能获得型（gain-of-function）增强子变异，这些变异分别改变了1,623个和1,247个ENCODE-cCRE增强子的功能。类似地，我们识别出4,057个候选从头增强子（de novo enhancer），由5,464个功能获得型变异产生。这些由DNABERT-Enhancer预测的全基因组增强子注释和候选遗传变异为功能和临床基因组学研究中的基因组解读提供了宝贵资源。可用性：DNABERT-Enhancer可在https://github.com/DavuluriLab/DNABERT-Enhancer免费获取；训练模型预测结果可通过网络应用程序https://dnabert-enhancer-datarepo.streamlit.app/进行交互式探索。微调模型已存档并通过Zenodo（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19157566）可引用。补充信息：补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。

documents.title: Epigenetic profiling of circulating cell-free DNA for early detection and minimal residual disease assessment in lung cancer: a focus on DNA methylation.
meta: Bazan Russo, Tancredi Didier; Gristina, Valerio; Delcuratolo, Marco Donatello; Tamburi, Leonardo; Delli Muti, Francesco; Mangiacotti, Filomena; Mujacic, Clarissa; Fanale, Daniele; Galvano, Antonio; Gori, Stefania; Incorvaia, Lorena; Giordano, Antonio; Pepe, Francesco; Malapelle, Umberto; Russo, Antonio; Muscarella, Lucia Anna; Fabrizio, Federico Pio
documents.summary: 该文综述cfDNA甲基化在肺癌早诊和MRD监测中的应用，虽提及染色质组织但非核心，无三维基因组建模或AI/分子模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
documents.abstract: Lung Cancer (LC) continues to be the biggest cause of cancer-related deaths around the world, mostly because of delayed diagnosis. Even if tissue biopsies and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) tests have revolutionized clinical management of LC patients, their effectiveness is restricted in settings with lower tumor burden, molecular heterogeneity, and bias in sampling approaches. In this scenario, the epigenetic profiling of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) stands out as a promising, less invasive approach, accurately detect cancer traces. Evidence from stage I-II disease and CT-detected pulmonary nodules supports the diagnostic potential of cfDNA methylation, although further validation in prospective screening cohorts remains necessary. Beyond genomic alterations, cfDNA epigenetic changes, including DNA methylation, chromatin organization, nucleosome positioning, and fragmentation patterns, reflect multi-dimensional complexity of tumor biology. These properties convey both the functional status and the origin of the circulating DNA fragments, accelerating for tumor integrating genomic analysis. Within this group, DNA methylation is the biologically robust and clinically well-established epigenetic marker, as alterations in methylation linked to cancer often occur in the early stages of tumorigenesis and are commonly found across different cancer cell types. Here, we explored the biological and clinical relevance of the epigenetic landscape of cfDNA in LC patients, particularly focusing on DNA methylation-based biomarkers and their evolving applications towards early diagnosis and post-surgical monitoring of minimal residual disease (MRD). We aimed to comprehensively overview analytical approaches for cfDNA methylation analysis, including targeted and genome-wide profiling strategies, and discuss their integration with machine learning (ML) and multi-omics frameworks in order to improve diagnostic performance and clinical applicability in LC management. 肺癌（Lung Cancer, LC）仍是全球癌症相关死亡的首要原因，主要归因于诊断延迟。尽管组织活检和循环肿瘤DNA（circulating tumor DNA, ctDNA）检测已彻底改变了LC患者的临床管理，但在肿瘤负荷较低、存在分子异质性以及采样方法存在偏倚的情况下，其有效性受到限制。在此背景下，游离DNA（cell-free DNA, cfDNA）的表观遗传学分析作为一种有前景、低侵入性的方法脱颖而出，能够准确检测癌症痕迹。来自I-II期疾病和CT检测到的肺结节的证据支持cfDNA甲基化的诊断潜力，尽管仍需在前瞻性筛查队列中进一步验证。除基因组改变外，cfDNA的表观遗传学变化，包括DNA甲基化、染色质组织、核小体定位和片段化模式，反映了肿瘤生物学的多维度复杂性。这些特性既传达了循环DNA片段的功能状态，也揭示了其组织来源，从而加速了肿瘤整合基因组分析。在这一类别中，DNA甲基化是生物学上稳健且临床验证充分的表观遗传学标志物，因为与癌症相关的甲基化改变通常发生在肿瘤发生的早期阶段，并且常见于不同癌细胞类型中。在此，我们探讨了LC患者cfDNA表观遗传学景观的生物学和临床相关性，特别关注基于DNA甲基化的生物标志物及其在早期诊断和微小残留病（minimal residual disease, MRD）术后监测中的演变应用。我们旨在全面概述cfDNA甲基化分析的分析方法，包括靶向和全基因组分析策略，并讨论其与机器学习（machine learning, ML）和多组学框架的整合，以提升LC管理中的诊断性能和临床适用性。

documents.title: Towards efficient perturbation for the noncoding genome.
meta: Zhang, Han; Luo, Shijie; Wang, Xiaofeng; Lin, Liquan; Liang, Ruipu; Zhong, Chunge; Zhang, Yunhan; Zhao, Wenchang; Chen, Zhisong; Liu, Xiaoya; Gao, Yunyan; Chen, Feng; Sun, Ning; Huang, Jialiang; Fei, Teng
documents.summary: 该文系统比较非编码基因组功能扰动工具并开发DeepDC深度学习模型优化双SpCas9设计，虽涉及顺式调控元件和深度学习，但核心是功能筛选而非染色质三维空间架构建模，与本课题关联较弱。
documents.abstract: Deciphering the functionality of the noncoding genome, which includes important cis-regulatory elements (CREs) and transcribed noncoding RNA genes, remains technically challenging. Here, using massively parallel genetic screening, we systematically benchmark the performance of five representative loss-of-function perturbation tools, including single-guide RNA (gRNA) mediated SpCas9 cleavage or CRISPR interference, and paired gRNA (pgRNA) involved dual-SpCas9, Big Papi (paired SpCas9 and SaCas9) or dual-enAsCas12a fragment deletion methods, in decoding the roles of the noncoding genome. For targeting CREs such as enhancers, dual-SpCas9 outperforms other methods with superior efficiency in destroying functional genomic regions. For perturbing noncoding RNA genes, in addition to dual-SpCas9, other RNA-targeting methods such as RNA interference are recommended to discriminate transcript-dependent or -independent roles. A deep learning model, DeepDC, with an associated web server, is built to facilitate optimal dual-SpCas9 pgRNA design for efficiently deleting a genomic fragment. Together, our work provides practical guidance on selecting appropriate loss-of-function tools to resolve the functional complexity of the noncoding genome. 破译非编码基因组的功能（包括重要的顺式调控元件（CREs）和转录的非编码RNA基因）在技术上仍具挑战性。在此，我们利用大规模并行遗传筛选，系统评估了五种代表性功能缺失扰动工具的性能，包括单导向RNA（gRNA）介导的SpCas9切割或CRISPR干扰，以及配对gRNA（pgRNA）参与的双SpCas9、Big Papi（配对SpCas9和SaCas9）或双enAsCas12a片段删除方法，以解码非编码基因组的作用。在靶向增强子等CREs时，双SpCas9在破坏功能性基因组区域方面效率更优，优于其他方法。在扰动非编码RNA基因时，除双SpCas9外，还推荐使用RNA干扰等其他RNA靶向方法，以区分转录依赖性或非依赖性作用。我们构建了一个深度学习模型DeepDC及其相关网络服务器，以优化双SpCas9 pgRNA设计，高效删除基因组片段。综上，我们的工作为选择合适的功能缺失工具以解析非编码基因组的复杂功能提供了实用指导。

documents.title: The periphery of nuclear speckles defines a spatially and temporally regulated compartment of long-lived intron-retained RNAs that resolves during mitosis.
meta: Biayna, Josep; Baranovskii, Artem; Chaudhuri, Anusha; Paladin, Marta; Erdem, Berkay; Keller, Luise-Elektra; Barutcu, A Rasim; Dimmeler, Stefanie; Marsico, Annalisa; Dumbovic, Gabrijela
documents.summary: 该文研究核斑周边RNA定位与内含子保留的时序调控，虽涉及RNA空间组织但非染色质三维结构建模，且AI方法仅用于序列特征预测，与染色质折叠/环挤出等核心问题无关。
documents.abstract: RNA localization adds a fundamental layer to gene expression by determining when and where translation-ready mRNAs become available, yet how this timing is coordinated with nuclear architecture and cell-cycle progression remains unclear. Here we identify a subnuclear RNA niche at the nuclear speckle periphery that couples intron retention to cell-cycle-timed RNA release. Using compartment-resolved transcriptional inhibition, sequence-based deep learning and single-molecule and super-resolution RNA imaging in human pluripotent stem cells, we define a class of nuclear RNAs with long-lived retained introns that persist for hours and are enriched in transcripts encoding regulators of genome maintenance and mitosis, including centromere and kinetochore assembly, DNA repair and telomere maintenance. Long-lived retained introns exhibit elevated GC content, predicted structural stability and enrichment for nuclear speckle-associated RNA-binding proteins. In interphase, these RNAs localize to a distinct nuclear speckle-peripheral RNA niche in a spatial arrangement conserved across cell types. During mitotic remodelling, they undergo coordinated, kinase-dependent splicing and are released into the cytoplasm of early G1 daughter cells. Together, these findings link cis-encoded intronic features, subnuclear organization and mitotic remodelling to temporal control of RNA fate. RNA定位通过决定翻译就绪的mRNA在何时何地可用，为基因表达增加了基础性层面，然而这一时机如何与核结构及细胞周期进程相协调仍不清楚。在此，我们识别出核斑周边的一个亚核RNA生态位，该生态位将内含子保留与细胞周期时序化的RNA释放相耦合。利用区室分辨的转录抑制、基于序列的深度学习以及人类多能干细胞中的单分子和超分辨率RNA成像，我们定义了一类具有长寿命保留内含子的核RNA，这些内含子持续数小时，并富集于编码基因组维持和有丝分裂调控因子的转录本中，包括着丝粒和动粒组装、DNA修复及端粒维持。长寿命保留内含子表现出升高的GC含量、预测的结构稳定性以及核斑相关RNA结合蛋白的富集。在间期，这些RNA定位于一个独特的核斑周边RNA生态位，其空间排列在不同细胞类型中保守。在有丝分裂重塑过程中，它们经历协调的、激酶依赖的剪接，并在早期G1子细胞中释放到细胞质。这些发现共同将顺式编码的内含子特征、亚核组织及有丝分裂重塑与RNA命运的时序控制联系起来。

documents.title: In vitro reconstitution of chromatin replication recapitulates symmetric histone recycling.
meta: Nagae, Fritz; Endo, Shizuko; Murayama, Yasuto; Terakawa, Tsuyoshi
documents.summary: 该文通过体外重建实验研究DNA复制中组蛋白对称回收的分子机制，虽涉及染色质结构但聚焦于组蛋白回收而非三维基因组空间架构建模，且方法以实验和测序为主，无AI或分子模拟方法贡献。
documents.abstract: Symmetric histone recycling is vital for maintaining epigenetic inheritance upon eukaryotic DNA replication. Recent genome-wide studies have uncovered key determinants of this process, but how these factors collectively support parental histone transfer remains incompletely understood. Here, we successfully reconstitute histone recycling with 24 purified proteins and analyze the products digested by Micrococcal nuclease with Repli-pore-seq, the newly developed pipeline combining nanopore sequencing and deep-learning-based classification. As a result, we identify histones symmetrically recycled as tetrasomes or hexasomes on nucleosome-favorable sequences. We also observe the discordance of the recycled position between lagging and leading strands on the GC-rich DNA sequences. Moreover, removal of Pol delta, Pol32, Dpb3/4, Ctf4, Csm3/Tof1, or Mrc1 disrupts the balance of histone recycling between the two daughter strands, whereas removal of Ctf4, Csm3/Tof1, or Mrc1 additionally alters the positions at which histones were recycled. Furthermore, addition of the lagging-strand maturation factors Fen1 and Cdc9 enhances histone recycling to the lagging strand. These findings provide critical insights into the molecular players and mechanisms underlying symmetric histone recycling. 对称性组蛋白回收对于真核生物DNA复制时维持表观遗传继承至关重要。近期的全基因组研究揭示了这一过程的关键决定因素，但这些因子如何协同支持亲本组蛋白转移仍未完全明了。在此，我们成功利用24种纯化蛋白重构了组蛋白回收过程，并通过新开发的结合纳米孔测序与深度学习分类的Repli-pore-seq流程，分析了经微球菌核酸酶消化的产物。结果，我们在核小体偏好序列上识别出以四聚体或六聚体形式对称回收的组蛋白。我们还观察到在富含GC的DNA序列上，后随链与前导链之间回收位置的不一致性。此外，去除Pol delta、Pol32、Dpb3/4、Ctf4、Csm3/Tof1或Mrc1会破坏两条子链间组蛋白回收的平衡，而去除Ctf4、Csm3/Tof1或Mrc1还会改变组蛋白回收的位置。进一步地，添加后随链成熟因子Fen1和Cdc9可增强组蛋白向后随链的回收。这些发现为对称性组蛋白回收的分子参与者及其机制提供了关键见解。

documents.title: Mechanisms underlying disease-causing variants in promoters and enhancers.
meta: Long, Hannah K; Wu, Kun; Barkham, Ryan S; Bickmore, Wendy A
documents.summary: 该文综述非编码单基因疾病变异在启动子和增强子中的致病机制，虽涉及顺式调控元件但未聚焦染色质三维空间架构建模，且方法上仅提及机器学习工具而无具体建模贡献，与课题核心方向关联较弱。
documents.abstract: The study of human monogenic disorders has been a powerful tool for generating a deep understanding of protein function/dysfunction and for uncovering underlying biological mechanisms. Here we explore the insights that an expanding catalog of noncoding monogenic disease variants can provide into the functions of the noncoding genome. We focus on small genetic alterations (one to a few tens of base pairs) in cis-regulatory elements-promoters, enhancers and silencers-and their potential mechanisms of action, such as loss or gain of function. We discuss the challenges in determining pathogenicity for variants in the noncoding genome, discuss why there might be so few concrete examples and highlight the opportunities for advancing this area of human genetics by using experimental and machine-learning tools. 人类单基因疾病的研究一直是深入理解蛋白质功能/功能障碍及揭示潜在生物学机制的强大工具。在此，我们探讨不断扩大的非编码单基因疾病变异目录能为非编码基因组功能提供哪些见解。我们聚焦于顺式调控元件——启动子、增强子和沉默子——中的小型遗传改变（一至几十个碱基对）及其潜在作用机制，如功能丧失或获得。我们讨论了确定非编码基因组变异致病性所面临的挑战，探讨了为何具体实例可能如此稀少，并强调了利用实验和机器学习工具推进人类遗传学这一领域的机遇。

documents.title: Flexible use of conserved motifs constrains genome access in cell type evolution.
meta: Chai, Chew; Gibson, Jesse; Li, Pengyang; McDonald, Brennan D; Pampari, Anusri; Patel, Aman; Kundaje, Anshul; Wang, Bo
documents.summary: 该文结合单细胞多组学与深度学习，研究跨物种细胞类型中染色质可及性的保守基序词汇与调控语法，虽聚焦染色质可及性而非三维结构，但其深度学习方法对理解染色质调控的进化约束有启发。
documents.abstract: Cell types can be organized into related families, but the regulatory mechanisms that define and maintain these families across deep evolutionary time remain unknown. Here, combining single-nucleus multi-omic sequencing with deep learning to analyse the accessible genomes of two groups of vastly divergent animals including flatworms and vertebrates, we find that hundreds of accessibility-dictating sequence motifs partition into distinct yet conserved sets, or 'vocabularies', each associated with a specific cell type family. However, combinatorial relationships among these motifs preferred by individual cell types are largely species specific. Deep-learning models trained on one species accurately predict family-level chromatin accessibility in distantly related species, albeit frequently rely on different motifs from shared vocabularies to reach convergent predictions. By contrast, models trained on individual cell types within a family lose cross-species predictive power, indicating that the regulatory syntax governing cell type-level identity evolves rapidly. We propose a 'collective maintenance' model in which motif vocabularies defining cell type families are evolutionarily stable, while recombination of these motifs generates cell type-specific regulatory programmes. This suggests that family identity is maintained collectively by large, conserved pools of regulatory factors, analogous to the logic of developmental homology, where character identity persists through network-level conservation despite extensive rewiring. 细胞类型可被组织为相关的家族，但定义并维持这些家族在深层进化时间尺度上的调控机制仍属未知。在此，我们结合单核多组学测序与深度学习，分析了两组高度分化的动物——包括扁虫和脊椎动物——的可及基因组，发现数百个决定可及性的序列基序分化为不同但保守的集合，或称为“词汇表”，每个词汇表与特定的细胞类型家族相关联。然而，单个细胞类型偏好的这些基序之间的组合关系在很大程度上是物种特异性的。在一种物种上训练的深度学习模型能准确预测远缘物种中的家族水平染色质可及性，尽管这些模型常常依赖共享词汇表中的不同基序来达成趋同预测。相比之下，在家族内单个细胞类型上训练的模型则丧失跨物种预测能力，表明调控细胞类型水平身份的调控语法进化迅速。我们提出一个“集体维持”模型，其中定义细胞类型家族的基序词汇表在进化上稳定，而这些基序的重组则生成细胞类型特异的调控程序。这表明家族身份由大型、保守的调控因子池集体维持，类似于发育同源性的逻辑，即特征身份通过网络级保守性持续存在，尽管存在广泛的重新布线。

documents.title: Overcoming Artificial Structures in Resolution-Enhanced Hi-C Data by Signal Decomposition and Multi-Scale Attention.
meta: Li, Qinyao; Li, Kelly Yichen; Nicoletti, Chiara; Tsui, Stephen Kwok-Wing; Puri, Pier Lorenzo; Cao, Qin; Yip, Kevin Y
documents.summary: 提出SHARP方法，通过信号分解与多尺度注意力机制提升Hi-C数据分辨率并避免人工结构，直接服务于染色质三维构象的高精度重建。
documents.abstract: Computational enhancement is an important strategy for inferring high-resolution features from genome-wide chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C) data, which typically have limited resolution. Deep learning has been highly successful in this task but we show that it creates prevalent artificial structures in the enhanced data due to the need to divide the large contact matrix into small patches. In addition, previous deep learning methods largely focus on local patterns, which cannot fully capture the complexity of Hi-C data. Here we propose Smooth, High-resolution, and Accurate Reconstruction of Patterns (SHARP) for enhancing Hi-C data. It uses the novel approach of decomposing the data into three types of signals, due to one-dimensional proximity, contiguous domains, and other fine structures, respectively, and applies deep learning only to the third type of signals, such that enhancement of the first two is unaffected by the patches. For the deep learning part, SHARP uses both local and global attention mechanisms to capture multi-scale contextual information. We compare SHARP with state-of-the-art methods extensively, including application to data from new samples and another species, and show that SHARP has superior performance in terms of resolution enhancement accuracy, avoiding creation of artificial structures, identifying significant interactions, and enrichment in chromatin states. 计算增强是从全基因组染色体构象捕获（Hi-C）数据中推断高分辨率特征的重要策略，而这类数据通常分辨率有限。深度学习在此任务中取得了巨大成功，但我们发现，由于需要将大型接触矩阵分割成小块，它会在增强数据中产生普遍的人造结构。此外，先前的深度学习方法主要关注局部模式，无法完全捕捉Hi-C数据的复杂性。在此，我们提出用于增强Hi-C数据的平滑、高分辨率与精确模式重建方法（SHARP）。它采用新颖的方法将数据分解为三种信号类型，分别源于一维邻近性、连续结构域及其他精细结构，并仅对第三种信号应用深度学习，从而使得前两种信号的增强不受分块影响。在深度学习部分，SHARP同时使用局部和全局注意力机制来捕捉多尺度上下文信息。我们将SHARP与最先进的方法进行了广泛比较，包括应用于新样本和另一物种的数据，结果表明SHARP在分辨率增强准确性、避免产生人造结构、识别显著相互作用以及染色质状态富集方面均具有优越性能。

documents.title: LAMBDA: a prophage detection benchmark for genomic language models.
meta: Lindsey, LeAnn M; Pershing, Nicole L; Dufault-Thompson, Keith; Gwak, Ho-Jin; Habib, Anisa; Schindler, Aaron; Rakheja, Arjun; Round, June L; Stephens, W Zac; Blaschke, Anne J; Sundar, Hari; Jiang, Xiaofang
documents.summary: 该文提出一个用于评估基因组语言模型的原噬菌体检测基准，不涉及三维基因组或染色质组织，且无AI/分子模拟方法贡献，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: Transformer-based genomic sequence models represent an emerging frontier in computational biology. Yet, their embeddings have not yet shown the same level of predictive power as natural and protein language models, highlighting a gap between current implementations and theoretical promise. Existing benchmarks for DNA language models primarily focus on classifying regulatory elements in eukaryotic genomes, leaving open the fundamental question of whether these models learn sequence-level features across whole genomes. We introduce LAMBDA, a benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate genome language model embeddings through phage-bacteria sequence discrimination across four categories of increasing complexity: probing tasks, fine-tuning assessments, diagnostic tests, and genome-wide prophage detection. Our comprehensive analysis of current genomic language models provides insight into the importance of training data selection relative to model size, the need for domain-specific training, and the capabilities and limitations of genomic language models for detecting prophage sequences. This benchmark represents a challenging genomic annotation task in the bacterial domain and addresses a key computational problem with direct relevance to microbiology and medicine. 基于Transformer的基因组序列模型代表了计算生物学的一个新兴前沿。然而，它们的嵌入尚未展现出与自然语言和蛋白质语言模型同等的预测能力，这凸显了当前实现与理论潜力之间的差距。现有的DNA语言模型基准主要侧重于真核生物基因组中调控元件的分类，而一个基本问题仍未得到解答：这些模型是否能在全基因组范围内学习序列级特征。我们提出了LAMBDA，这是一个基准测试，旨在通过噬菌体-细菌序列判别来严格评估基因组语言模型的嵌入，该判别涵盖四个复杂度递增的类别：探测任务 (probing tasks)、微调评估 (fine-tuning assessments)、诊断测试 (diagnostic tests) 和全基因组前噬菌体检测 (genome-wide prophage detection)。我们对当前基因组语言模型的全面分析揭示了训练数据选择相对于模型大小的重要性、领域特定训练的必要性，以及基因组语言模型在检测前噬菌体序列方面的能力与局限性。该基准代表了细菌域中一项具有挑战性的基因组注释任务，并解决了一个与微生物学和医学直接相关的关键计算问题。

documents.title: A Novel De Novo STAG1 Variant at the RAD21 Binding Interface Is Associated With Hypoglycemia, Recurrent Fever, Immunodeficiency and Features of Classical Cohesinopathies.
meta: Hussain, Hafiz Muhammad Jafar; Zimmermann, Michael; Safgren, Stephanie L; Farris, Joseph D; Panwar, Deepak; Thurman, Sarah Allen; Muthusamy, Karthik; Urrutia, Raul; Wick, Myra J; E Vairo, Filippo Pinto; Klee, Eric W
documents.summary: 该文报道一例STAG1新发变异导致黏连蛋白病，虽使用分子动力学模拟分析变异对RAD21结合界面的影响，但对象为黏连蛋白复合物而非染色质三维组织，且未涉及TAD、环挤出等染色质高级结构建模，方法贡献有限。
documents.abstract: The cohesin complex, composed of SMC1, SMC3, RAD21, and STAG1/STAG2, is essential for chromosome cohesion, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation. Pathogenic variants in cohesin components cause cohesinopathies. The classical characteristics of cohesinopathies include developmental delay (DD), intellectual disability (ID), feeding difficulties, hypotonia, short stature, hearing loss, and dysmorphic features. Here, we present a 5-year-old boy with classical cohesinopathy features, including DD/ID and feeding difficulties, along with non-classical features such as hypoglycemia, recurrent fever, and immunodeficiency. Trio exome sequencing identified a novel de novo missense variant of uncertain significance (NM_005862.3:c.643G>A(p.Val215Ile)) in the STAG1 gene. The variant localizes to the RAD21 interaction interface, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed conformational changes comparable to other STAG1 variants reported as likely pathogenic in patients, supporting a deleterious effect which may disrupt the STAG1-RAD21 interaction interface. This case expands the phenotypic and molecular spectrum of STAG1-related cohesinopathy and advances our understanding of the disease mechanism. 由SMC1、SMC3、RAD21和STAG1/STAG2组成的黏连蛋白复合体（cohesin complex）对于染色体黏连、DNA修复和转录调控至关重要。黏连蛋白组分中的致病性变异会导致黏连蛋白病（cohesinopathies）。黏连蛋白病的典型特征包括发育迟缓（DD）、智力障碍（ID）、喂养困难、肌张力低下、身材矮小、听力损失和畸形特征。本文报告一名5岁男性患儿，具有典型黏连蛋白病特征（包括DD/ID和喂养困难），同时伴有非典型特征如低血糖、反复发热和免疫缺陷。三人全外显子组测序（Trio exome sequencing）在STAG1基因中发现一个意义未明的新生错义变异（NM_005862.3:c.643G>A(p.Val215Ile)）。该变异定位于RAD21相互作用界面，分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟显示其构象变化与患者中报告为可能致病性的其他STAG1变异相当，支持其可能破坏STAG1-RAD21相互作用界面的有害效应。本病例扩展了STAG1相关黏连蛋白病的表型与分子谱系，并增进了对该疾病机制的理解。

documents.title: Loss of SUMOylation drives aberrant PRC1 clustering and 3D genome rewiring independent of H3K27me3.
meta: Akilli, Nazli; Puel, Paul-Swann; Stefano, Marco Di; Muzzopappa, Fernando; Fritsch, Lauriane; Erdel, Fabian; Jost, Daniel; Cheutin, Thierry; Cavalli, Giacomo
documents.summary: 该文通过实验与生物物理建模揭示SUMO化修饰调控PRC1凝聚体特性并重塑TAD互作网络，直接关联染色质三维组织与转录调控，方法上结合了凝聚体建模与Hi-C分析，对理解染色质空间架构的调控机制有重要启发。
documents.abstract: Polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) forms nuclear condensates that organize target chromatin domains. SUMOylation modulates PRC1 clustering, but its impact on condensate properties and 3D genome architecture remains unclear. Here, we show that depletion of small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) in Drosophila wing imaginal discs transforms PRC1 condensates into large structures with reduced molecular dynamics. Biophysical modeling suggests that the changes in PRC1 self-interactions are responsible for the formation of large PRC1 condensates when SUMO is depleted. Interestingly, this biophysical reorganization occurs without global loss of the H3K27me3 mark. Instead, Hi-C reveals widespread rewiring of topologically associating domain (TAD) interactions. PRC1-bound TADs lose specific long-range contacts with each other while gaining ectopic interactions with active chromatin. These topological shifts correlate with gene misregulation independently of changes in Polycomb histone modifications. Our results establish SUMOylation as a critical regulator of PRC1 condensates, demonstrating that post-translational control of biomolecular condensation modulates 3D genome architecture and transcriptional output through mechanisms separable from histone mark deposition. Polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) 形成核凝聚体，组织靶染色质结构域。SUMOylation 调节 PRC1 的聚集，但其对凝聚体性质和 3D 基因组结构的影响仍不清楚。在此，我们展示在果蝇翅成虫盘中去除 small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) 会将 PRC1 凝聚体转变为具有降低分子动力学的大结构。生物物理模型表明，当 SUMO 被去除时，PRC1 自相互作用的改变是形成大 PRC1 凝聚体的原因。有趣的是，这种生物物理重组发生在没有全局性丢失 H3K27me3 标记的情况下。相反，Hi-C 揭示了拓扑关联结构域 (TAD) 相互作用的广泛重连。PRC1 结合的 TAD 彼此失去特定的长程接触，同时获得与活跃染色质的异位相互作用。这些拓扑变化与基因失调相关，且独立于 Polycomb 组蛋白修饰的变化。我们的结果确立了 SUMOylation 作为 PRC1 凝聚体的关键调节因子，证明通过可分离于组蛋白标记沉积的机制，生物分子凝聚的翻译后控制调节 3D 基因组结构和转录输出。

documents.title: Plant cis-regulatory grammar: Decoding the multidimensional code of transcriptional regulation for programmable crop engineering.
documents.summary: 该综述系统阐述植物顺式调控元件的多维调控语法，涵盖染色质可及性、组蛋白修饰及三维基因组拓扑等空间组织特征，并强调AI驱动的预测性工程与调控语法基础模型，虽以植物CRE为对象且偏综述，但其三维基因组与AI结合框架对染色质空间架构建模有直接启发。
documents.abstract: Cis-regulatory elements (CREs) orchestrate the spatiotemporal precision of gene expression that underlies plant development, adaptation, and domestication. Decoding the cis-regulatory grammar of plant genomes remains a central challenge in modern biology, with profound implications for programmable crop engineering. Here, recent conceptual and technological advances are synthesized to reshape our understanding of plant CREs. This review first argues that CRE function is not only an intrinsic property of DNA sequence alone but also emerges from a multidimensional context, including chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, three-dimensional genome topology, and cell type-specific regulatory landscapes. Furthermore, the convergence of single-cell epigenomics, high-throughput functional assays, and CRISPR-based dissection has begun to unravel this contextual grammar, revealing the computational principles governing transcriptional regulation. Critically, we propose that artificial intelligence (AI) platforms are catalyzing an ongoing transition from descriptive discovery to predictive engineering, wherein these platforms outperform natural evolution in designing synthetic CREs. Finally, a roadmap is outlined toward a plant regulatory grammar foundation model, which will enable truly predictive engineering of gene expression when fine-tuned for specific tasks. Collectively, the integration of single-cell resolution maps, precise genome editing, AI-driven design, and regulatory-compliant delivery systems promises to transform our ability to reprogram plant gene regulation for next-generation agriculture, bridging the gap between foundational regulatory biology and tangible crop improvement. 顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements, CREs）协调基因表达的时空精确性，这是植物发育、适应和驯化的基础。解码植物基因组的顺式调控语法仍是现代生物学的核心挑战，对可编程作物工程具有深远意义。本文综合了近期概念和技术进展，以重塑我们对植物CREs的理解。本综述首先论证，CRE功能不仅是DNA序列的内在属性，还源于多维背景，包括染色质可及性、组蛋白修饰、三维基因组拓扑结构及细胞类型特异性调控景观。此外，单细胞表观基因组学、高通量功能检测和基于CRISPR的解析技术的融合已开始揭示这一背景语法，阐明了调控转录的计算原理。关键的是，我们提出人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）平台正催化从描述性发现到预测性工程的持续转变，这些平台在设计合成CREs方面超越自然进化。最后，我们勾勒出通往植物调控语法基础模型的路线图，该模型在针对特定任务微调后将实现真正预测性的基因表达工程。总体而言，单细胞分辨率图谱、精确基因组编辑、AI驱动设计及符合监管的递送系统的整合，有望转变我们重编程植物基因调控的能力，以支持下一代农业，弥合基础调控生物学与实质性作物改良之间的鸿沟。

documents.title: PromptBio: An Agentic Platform for End-to-End Computational Biomedical Research
meta: Zhang M; Gu W; Han B; Guo W; Chen J; Zhou X; Leng Y; Ma Y; Li K; Zheng J; Shishir H; Wang W; Huang A; Shashidhar K; Yang X
documents.summary: 该文介绍一个多智能体AI平台PromptBio，用于端到端计算生物医学研究，但未涉及三维基因组/染色质组织建模或AI/分子模拟方法，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: Modern biomedical research increasingly depends on complex computational analyses, yet translating a scientific question into a reliable workflow still requires substantial technical expertise and manual coordination. PromptBio is a multi-agent AI platform available through a web portal at https://promptbio.ai that addresses this challenge. Through natural-language interaction, its agent harness, PromptGenie, translates a research objective into an inspectable plan, executes the required research and analysis, and adapts subsequent steps as evidence and results emerge. PromptBio integrates reasoning with managed execution while preserving human oversight and a traceable record of the research process. It can apply validated methods, construct custom analyses, and incorporate external workflows, enabling researchers to move beyond fixed pipelines while supporting reproducibility. We evaluate the platform through benchmarks of end-to-end bioinformatics analysis and biomedical deep research, validation of representative omics and machine-learning skills, and a hypothesis-driven regulatory-genomics case study. PromptGenie achieved higher analytical accuracy and stronger evidence retrieval and synthesis than the comparison agents, while the evaluated domain skills produced results consistent with established methods. The case study further demonstrates how PromptBio can integrate human-specific genomic and epigenomic features to investigate cortical development. Together, these findings show that PromptBio can coordinate complex biomedical analyses under researcher oversight, offering an accessible approach for accelerating scientific iteration and transforming research questions into transparent, reusable computational workflows. 现代生物医学研究日益依赖复杂的计算分析，但将科学问题转化为可靠的工作流程仍需要大量的技术专长和人工协调。PromptBio 是一个可通过网页门户（https://promptbio.ai）访问的多智能体AI平台，旨在应对这一挑战。通过自然语言交互，其智能体工具集 PromptGenie 将研究目标转化为可检查的计划，执行所需的研究与分析，并根据证据和结果的出现调整后续步骤。PromptBio 将推理与受控执行相结合，同时保留人工监督和研究过程的可追溯记录。它可以应用已验证的方法、构建定制分析并整合外部工作流程，使研究人员能够超越固定流程，同时支持可重复性。我们通过端到端生物信息学分析和生物医学深度研究的基准测试、代表性组学和机器学习技能的验证，以及一个假设驱动的调控基因组学案例研究来评估该平台。与对比智能体相比，PromptGenie 实现了更高的分析准确性以及更强的证据检索与综合能力，而评估的领域技能产生的结果与既定方法一致。案例研究进一步展示了 PromptBio 如何整合人类特异性基因组和表观基因组特征来研究皮层发育。综合这些发现表明，PromptBio 能够在研究人员监督下协调复杂的生物医学分析，提供一种可及的方法来加速科学迭代，并将研究问题转化为透明、可复用的计算工作流程。

documents.title: Shared Treg dysregulation underlies psoriasis vulgaris and atopic dermatitis through the PHF19-PRC2 epigenetic axis.
meta: Lin, Yiting; Su, Xiaolei; Jin, Mingzhu; Wang, Yuqi; Li, Yaoyao; Zong, Bingquan; Song, Haoran; Lv, Yajie; Liu, Zhenhua; Wang, Gang; Wu, Shengxi
documents.summary: 该文研究银屑病和特应性皮炎中Treg细胞亚群失调的共享机制，不涉及三维基因组、染色质组织或空间架构建模，且无AI/分子模拟方法。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis vulgaris (PV) and atopic dermatitis (AD) are chronic inflammatory skin diseases characterized by distinct dominant T cell subsets, yet emerging evidence suggests overlapping immune mechanisms. Whether a shared Treg abnormality underlies both diseases remains unclear. METHODS: Single-cell RNA sequencing data from lesional T cells of 8 PV, 7 AD, and 7 healthy controls were analyzed. Treg subset identification, trajectory, communication, and enrichment analyses were conducted. Differentially expressed genes from both diseases were intersected and subjected to Mendelian randomization to screen for shared causal genes, followed by interaction mapping, drug prediction, and molecular docking. Findings were validated in Foxp3-tdTomato reporter mouse models of imiquimod-induced psoriasis-like and MC903-induced AD-like dermatitis by flow cytometry and quantitative PCR. RESULTS: A shared Treg triad remodeling pattern was identified: central memory Treg (cmTreg) was almost completely depleted, cycling Treg (Treg-c) expanded, and effector Treg (eTreg) accumulated in both diseases. Pseudotemporal analysis revealed a differentiation coordination defect, with upstream Treg-c shifting prematurely while effector Treg failed terminal maturation. Cell communication analysis identified enhanced MIF-(CD74+CXCR4/CD44) signaling as a shared intercellular remodeling axis, with the network shifting from a cmTreg-centric topology to one jointly centered on Treg-c and eTreg. Mendelian randomization identified seven shared causal genes (PDCD5, PHF19, GNAQ, LRR1, DHX36, TMEM107, FAM200B), with PHF19 serving as a core accessory subunit of PRC2. Molecular docking and in vivo experiments demonstrated that resveratrol binds PHF19, is predicted to activate the PHF19-PRC2-H3K27me3 axis, restores Treg subset homeostasis, and ameliorates skin lesions in both models. CONCLUSIONS: Treg subset remodeling is a shared pathogenic feature, nominating PHF19-targeted activation as a tolerance-restoring therapeutic strategy. 背景：寻常型银屑病（psoriasis vulgaris, PV）和特应性皮炎（atopic dermatitis, AD）是以不同主导T细胞亚群为特征的慢性炎症性皮肤病，但新证据提示存在重叠的免疫机制。两者是否共享一种Treg异常机制尚不清楚。方法：分析了8例PV、7例AD和7例健康对照皮损T细胞的单细胞RNA测序数据。进行了Treg亚群鉴定、轨迹分析、细胞通讯分析和富集分析。将两种疾病的差异表达基因取交集，并通过孟德尔随机化筛选共享因果基因，随后进行相互作用图谱构建、药物预测和分子对接。在咪喹莫特诱导的银屑病样和MC903诱导的AD样皮炎Foxp3-tdTomato报告小鼠模型中，通过流式细胞术和定量PCR验证发现。结果：鉴定出一种共享的Treg三联体重塑模式：在两种疾病中，中央记忆Treg（cmTreg）几乎完全耗竭，循环Treg（Treg-c）扩增，效应Treg（eTreg）积累。伪时间分析显示分化协调缺陷，上游Treg-c过早转变，而效应Treg未能完成终末成熟。细胞通讯分析发现增强的MIF-(CD74+CXCR4/CD44)信号是共享的细胞间重塑轴，网络从以cmTreg为中心的拓扑结构转变为以Treg-c和eTreg共同为中心的结构。孟德尔随机化鉴定出七个共享因果基因（PDCD5、PHF19、GNAQ、LRR1、DHX36、TMEM107、FAM200B），其中PHF19是PRC2的核心辅助亚基。分子对接和体内实验表明，白藜芦醇与PHF19结合，预测可激活PHF19-PRC2-H3K27me3轴，恢复Treg亚群稳态，并改善两种模型的皮损。结论：Treg亚群重塑是共享的致病特征，提示靶向PHF19激活是一种恢复免疫耐受的治疗策略。

documents.title: Geometric mechanogenomics: engineering boundary conditions for deterministic cell fate control.
meta: Taghizadeh, Mohsen; Taghizadeh, Ali; Kim, Hye Sung
Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
documents.summary: 该文提出几何力学基因组学框架，探讨几何边界条件通过力学传导调控染色质组织和基因组调控，虽涉及染色质组织但为概念性综述，缺乏具体AI或分子模拟建模方法。
documents.abstract: In tissue development and regeneration, cellular behavior has traditionally been interpreted through biochemical signaling frameworks. However, cells exist within physically defined environments, where geometric boundary conditions - including confinement, curvature, anisotropy, and multicellular architecture - define the mechanical state space in which mechanical forces are generated, transmitted, and interpreted. Here, we introduce geometric mechanogenomics, a conceptual framework that positions geometry as an upstream spatial regulator linking tissue-scale boundary conditions to nuclear mechanics, chromatin organization, and genome regulation. We propose a boundary-to-nucleus axis through which geometric information is decoded by adhesion-mediated mechanotransduction, cytoskeletal force transmission, and nuclear mechanoregulation to regulate chromatin accessibility, epigenetic remodeling, and transcriptional programs. Rather than introducing new mechanotransduction pathways, this framework emphasizes that geometry spatially organizes conserved mechanotransductive machinery to generate context-dependent mechanogenomic outcomes. We further discuss how engineered geometries reduce morphogenetic stochasticity, coordinate multicellular organization, and establish mechanical memory that influences long-term cell fate. Finally, we highlight current challenges in establishing predictive geometry-to-genome relationships and discuss emerging opportunities enabled by spatial omics, artificial intelligence-assisted inverse design, and dynamic biomaterials for programmable mechanobiology, regenerative medicine, developmental biology, and disease modeling. 在组织发育与再生过程中，细胞行为传统上通过生化信号框架进行解读。然而，细胞存在于物理定义的环境中，其中几何边界条件——包括限制（confinement）、曲率（curvature）、各向异性（anisotropy）以及多细胞结构（multicellular architecture）——定义了机械力产生、传递和解读的力学状态空间。在此，我们提出几何力学生物组学（geometric mechanogenomics），这是一个概念框架，将几何定位为上游空间调控因子，连接组织尺度的边界条件与细胞核力学、染色质组织及基因组调控。我们提出一个从边界到细胞核的轴（boundary-to-nucleus axis），通过该轴，几何信息由黏附介导的力转导（adhesion-mediated mechanotransduction）、细胞骨架力传递（cytoskeletal force transmission）和细胞核力学调控（nuclear mechanoregulation）进行解码，以调控染色质可及性、表观遗传重塑及转录程序。该框架并非引入新的力转导通路，而是强调几何在空间上组织保守的力转导机制，以产生依赖于上下文的力学生物组学结果。我们进一步讨论了工程化几何如何减少形态发生随机性、协调多细胞组织，并建立影响长期细胞命运的机械记忆。最后，我们强调了在建立可预测的几何-基因组关系方面当前面临的挑战，并探讨了由空间组学（spatial omics）、人工智能辅助逆向设计（artificial intelligence-assisted inverse design）以及动态生物材料（dynamic biomaterials）所带来的新兴机遇，这些技术可用于可编程力学生物学（programmable mechanobiology）、再生医学（regenerative medicine）、发育生物学（developmental biology）及疾病建模（disease modeling）。

documents.title: Hi-cGAN: Prediction of Hi-C interaction matrices with conditional generative adversarial networks
meta: Krauth R; Kumar A; Wolff J
documents.summary: 该文提出基于条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）的Hi-cGAN模型，从染色质因子占据数据预测Hi-C互作矩阵，直接针对三维基因组空间组织建模，方法新颖且与AI深度学习高度相关。
documents.abstract:
Background

The three-dimensional organization of the genome is a fundamental aspect of its function and regulation. High-throughput chromosome conformation capture techniques, such as Hi-C, have revolutionized our understanding of spatial genome organization. However, 3C-based methods are resource-intensive and technically demanding. This has driven the development of computational approaches for predicting Hi-C interaction matrices. Hi-cGAN, a novel approach based on conditional generative adversarial networks, offers a computational alternative to extensive wet-lab work by predicting Hi-C interaction matrices. This computational approach contributes to a broader exploration and understanding of genome architecture.

Findings

The network pairs a convolutional generator with a convolutional discriminator, evaluated across bin sizes, inputs and cell types. It predicts a whole genome as a cool file at bin sizes from 2 to 25 kb, where Akita, C.Origami and Epiphany emit fixed windows of 1 Mb, 2 Mb and 990 kb. With the input chosen on a validation chromosome, agreement approaches Epiphany’s and stays below the sequence-based C.Origami and Akita: over Akita’s 411 held-out windows the mean correlation is 0.238 against 0.506. Boundary and loop calls agree less closely, placing the maps at the domain scale.

Conclusions

Chromatin factor occupancy determines a substantial part of contact structure, and two tracks capture most of it. The most informative track depends on the resolution: CTCF and the cohesin subunits at 5 to 10 kb, active histone marks at 25 kb. Transfer to an unseen cell type costs about 0.12 SCC, and which method leads depends on the measure.

Key points

Hi-cGAN predicts Hi-C interaction matrices with a conditional generative adversarial network from chromatin factor occupancy alone, without DNA sequence. The same architecture learns raw contact counts, genomic-distance z-scores and observed/ expected normalized data. On held-out data Hi-cGAN reaches matrix-level agreement slightly below Epiphany’s, when the input configuration is chosen on a validation chromosome rather than the chromosomes scored, and well below C.Origami’s and Akita’s, which read DNA sequence. Which method is better depends on the measure used, and boundary and loop recovery does not follow the matrix-level scores. A ridge regression on the same single track reaches 0.691 against Hi-cGAN’s 0.715 on HiCRep, while its predicted matrix shows stripes but no domains, so that measure alone does not establish what the network contributes. Bin sizes of 2 to 25 kb are evaluated and freely configurable, whole chromosomes are predicted, and the result is written as a cool file, whereas the sequence-based methods emit a single fixed window.

背景

基因组的三维组织是其功能和调控的基本方面。高通量染色体构象捕获技术，如Hi-C，彻底改变了我们对空间基因组组织的理解。然而，基于3C的方法资源密集且技术要求高。这推动了用于预测Hi-C相互作用矩阵的计算方法的发展。Hi-cGAN，一种基于条件生成对抗网络的新方法，通过预测Hi-C相互作用矩阵，为广泛的湿实验工作提供了一种计算替代方案。这种计算方法有助于更广泛地探索和理解基因组结构。

发现

该网络将卷积生成器与卷积判别器配对，并在不同bin大小、输入和细胞类型下进行评估。它以2至25 kb的bin大小预测整个基因组为cool文件，而Akita、C.Origami和Epiphany则输出1 Mb、2 Mb和990 kb的固定窗口。当输入在验证染色体上选择时，一致性接近Epiphany的水平，但低于基于序列的C.Origami和Akita：在Akita的411个保留窗口上，平均相关性为0.238，而后者为0.506。边界和环调用的一致性较低，将图谱置于域尺度。

结论

染色质因子占据决定了接触结构的相当大一部分，而两个轨道捕获了其中的大部分。最具信息量的轨道取决于分辨率：在5至10 kb时是CTCF和cohesin亚基，在25 kb时是活性组蛋白标记。转移到未见过的细胞类型大约损失0.12 SCC，而哪种方法领先取决于度量标准。

关键点

Hi-cGAN仅利用染色质因子占据，通过条件生成对抗网络预测Hi-C相互作用矩阵，而不依赖DNA序列。相同的架构学习原始接触计数、基因组距离z分数和观察/期望归一化数据。在保留数据上，当输入配置在验证染色体而非评分染色体上选择时，Hi-cGAN达到的矩阵级一致性略低于Epiphany，且远低于读取DNA序列的C.Origami和Akita。哪种方法更好取决于所用度量，而边界和环恢复并不遵循矩阵级分数。在相同单轨道上的岭回归在HiCRep上达到0.691，而Hi-cGAN为0.715，但其预测矩阵显示条纹而无域，因此仅凭该度量无法确定网络的贡献。评估了2至25 kb的bin大小且可自由配置，预测整个染色体，结果写入cool文件，而基于序列的方法输出单一固定窗口。

documents.title: HiC-LEGO: Biologically Guided High-Resolution 3D Genome Reconstruction Preserves Chromatin Organization at Kilobase Resolution
meta: Abhishek Pandeya; Md Fahimul Kabir Chowdhury; Oluwatosin Oluwadare
documents.summary: 提出HiC-LEGO，一种结合染色质结构域集成与图学习的分层框架，从Hi-C数据高分辨率重建三维基因组，保留TAD、增强子-启动子互作等染色质组织特征。
documents.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) chromosome reconstruction from Hi-C contact maps remains challenging because genome organization is hierarchical and fine-resolution models must reconcile local structure with chromosome-scale constraints. Here we present HiC-LEGO, a domain-aware hierarchical framework integrating ensemble chromatin domains with graph-based structural learning and progressive chromosome assembly. By combining ensemble domain selection with hierarchical reconstruction, HiC-LEGO reduces dependence on individual domain definitions while maintaining local organization during chromosome-scale assembly. Across five human cell lines at 5-kb resolution, HiC-LEGO achieves higher reconstruction concordance than evaluated state-of-the-art methods while better preserving domain organization. At 1-kb resolution, HiC-LEGO reconstructs complete GM12878 chromosome 8 and recovers close spatial proximity between an epigenomically supported distal MYC enhancer and its promoter. Reconstructions from 5-kb Micro-C data show that 249 experimentally defined RCMC microcompartment interactions at the Ppm1g locus occupy compact 3D configurations. In the breast cancer dataset, HiC-LEGO reconstructs structures that maintain stable TAD organization across healthy breast, primary tumors, and liver metastases, while revealing greater inter-patient structural heterogeneity in malignant pleural effusion samples. Pore-C validation shows that experimentally observed multi-way contacts spanning 1–5 Mb are enriched in compact reconstructed configurations across all 23 chromosomes. Thus, HiC-LEGO preserves regulatory interactions, disease-associated chromatin organization and higher-order spatial relationships beyond pairwise contact-map concordance. 从Hi-C接触图谱进行三维（3D）染色体重建仍具挑战性，因为基因组组织具有层级性，且精细分辨率模型必须协调局部结构与染色体尺度约束。在此，我们提出HiC-LEGO，一种域感知的层级框架，整合了集成染色质域、基于图的结构学习和渐进式染色体组装。通过结合集成域选择与层级重建，HiC-LEGO减少了对单个域定义的依赖，同时在染色体尺度组装中保持局部组织。在五种人类细胞系中，以5-kb分辨率，HiC-LEGO实现了比评估的最先进方法更高的重建一致性，同时更好地保留了域组织。在1-kb分辨率下，HiC-LEGO重建了完整的GM12878染色体8，并恢复了表观基因组支持的远端MYC增强子与其启动子之间的紧密空间邻近性。来自5-kb Micro-C数据的重建显示，Ppm1g基因座上249个实验定义的RCMC微区室相互作用占据紧凑的3D构型。在乳腺癌数据集中，HiC-LEGO重建的结构在健康乳腺、原发肿瘤和肝转移中维持稳定的TAD组织，同时揭示恶性胸腔积液样本中更大的患者间结构异质性。Pore-C验证显示，实验观察到的跨越1–5 Mb的多向接触在所有23条染色体的紧凑重建构型中富集。因此，HiC-LEGO在成对接触图谱一致性之外，还保留了调控相互作用、疾病相关染色质组织和更高阶的空间关系。

documents.title: LLM-guided prediction of riboswitch-ligand binding affinity under data-limited conditions.
meta: An, Sunggi; Mun, Sofia; Jung, Yousung; Kim, Hyun Uk
documents.summary: 该文用LLM嵌入和领域规则预测核糖开关-配体结合亲和力，对象为RNA调控元件而非染色质三维组织，且无空间架构建模或可迁移的染色质方法，仅与基因组调控间接相关。
documents.abstract: Riboswitches are RNA regulatory elements that sense small molecules and regulate gene expression through ligand-induced conformational changes in an aptamer domain. They enable synthetic biology applications such as biosensing and gene circuit design. Accurate prediction of riboswitch-ligand binding affinity, quantified by the dissociation constant (K(d)), is essential for rational riboswitch engineering. We present a neuro-symbolic framework in which LLM-derived embeddings encode riboswitch sequences, secondary structures, and ligand representations into a unified representation that captures riboswitch-ligand interaction context, while domain-informed rules encode explicit biochemical priors. Despite limited labeled data, this framework achieves strong predictive performance and improved data efficiency. It predicts min-max log-scaled pK(d) values and supports binary classification of binding strength, particularly by mitigating systematic overestimation of affinity. More broadly, the results suggest that LLM-based neuro-symbolic representations provide an effective route for modeling riboswitch-ligand interactions under data-limited conditions. 核糖开关（riboswitch）是RNA调控元件，通过适配体结构域中的配体诱导构象变化来感知小分子并调节基因表达。它们支持合成生物学应用，如生物传感和基因电路设计。准确预测核糖开关-配体结合亲和力，以解离常数（K(d)）量化，对于理性核糖开关工程至关重要。我们提出了一种神经符号框架，其中LLM衍生的嵌入将核糖开关序列、二级结构和配体表示编码为统一表示，以捕获核糖开关-配体相互作用上下文，而领域信息规则则编码明确的生化先验。尽管标记数据有限，该框架仍实现了强大的预测性能和更高的数据效率。它预测最小-最大对数标度的pK(d)值，并支持结合强度的二元分类，特别是通过缓解亲和力的系统性高估。更广泛地，结果表明，基于LLM的神经符号表示为在数据受限条件下建模核糖开关-配体相互作用提供了有效途径。

documents.title: 3D epigenome of glial cell types in developing human cortex.
meta: Jones, Ian R; Wang, Li; Kosicki, Michael; Battle, Stephanie L; Narayan, Vivek Jj; Bi, Qiuli; Gemenes, Kaila; Liu, Yuxi; Zhou, Lingbo; Song, Mengyi; White, Matthew; Olson, Wendy; Beuchat, Gabriel; Dickel, Diane; Li, Yun; Pennacchio, Len A; Hawkins, R David; Kriegstein, Arnold; Shen, Yin
documents.summary: 该研究整合3D染色质互作、可及性、甲基化等多组学数据，对发育中人类皮层胶质细胞类型进行三维表观基因组分析，并用机器学习优先排序精神分裂症风险变异，虽涉及染色质环和细胞类型特异性调控，但以实验组学为主，AI仅用于变异筛选，缺乏染色质三维架构建模深度。
documents.abstract: The human cortex is complex and heterogeneous, undergoing extensive expansion during development(1,2). Our prior study of neurogenesis, including radial glia (RG), intermediate progenitor cells, excitatory neurons and interneurons demonstrated that chromatin looping underlies transcriptional regulation for lineage-specific genes, shedding light on how non-coding genetic variants contribute to neuropsychiatric disorders by means of cell-type-specific gene regulation(3). RG have a crucial role in generating cellular diversity through both neurogenesis and gliogenesis and can be further classified into ventricular RG (vRG) and outer RG (oRG)(4,5). Given their significance in cortical development, we conducted a comprehensive three-dimensional (3D) epigenomic analysis of four main glial populations, including vRG, oRG, oligodendrocyte precursor cells and microglia, from the mid-gestational human neocortex. By integrating gene expression, chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation and 3D chromatin interactions, we identified cell-type-specific candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs) and validated their regulatory function using transgenic mouse embryos. Using machine learning, we prioritized 112 schizophrenia risk variants within glia cCREs and further confirmed the predicted vRG enhancer disruption by the rs4449074 risk allele in vivo. Finally, oRG cCREs are enriched for human accelerated regions compared with other cCREs and a subset of human accelerated regions show activity differences from their chimpanzee orthologues that interact with genes involved in neuronal development. Our findings advance the understanding of human-specific gene regulation during corticogenesis. 人类大脑皮层复杂且异质，在发育过程中经历广泛扩张(1,2)。我们先前对神经发生（包括放射状胶质细胞 (radial glia, RG)、中间前体细胞、兴奋性神经元和中间神经元）的研究表明，染色质环化是谱系特异性基因转录调控的基础，揭示了非编码遗传变异如何通过细胞类型特异性基因调控导致神经精神疾病(3)。RG通过神经发生和胶质发生对产生细胞多样性起关键作用，并可进一步分为脑室区RG (ventricular RG, vRG) 和外侧RG (outer RG, oRG)(4,5)。鉴于它们在皮层发育中的重要性，我们对来自中孕期人类新皮层的四种主要胶质细胞群体（包括vRG、oRG、少突胶质前体细胞和小胶质细胞）进行了全面的三维 (three-dimensional, 3D) 表观基因组分析。通过整合基因表达、染色质可及性、DNA甲基化和3D染色质相互作用，我们鉴定了细胞类型特异性候选顺式调控元件 (candidate cis-regulatory elements, cCREs)，并利用转基因小鼠胚胎验证了其调控功能。利用机器学习，我们在胶质细胞cCREs中优先筛选出112个精神分裂症风险变异，并进一步在体内证实了rs4449074风险等位基因对预测的vRG增强子的破坏作用。最后，与其他cCREs相比，oRG cCREs富集了人类加速区域 (human accelerated regions)，且其中一部分人类加速区域与其黑猩猩直系同源序列相比表现出活性差异，这些差异与参与神经元发育的基因相互作用。我们的发现推进了对皮层发生过程中人类特异性基因调控的理解。

documents.title: Artificial intelligence-guided engineering of precision ocular therapeutics.
meta: Sayana, Ruhi; Wang, Sean K; Ting, Daniel S W; Guo, Lucie Y
documents.summary: 综述AI在眼科小分子与基因治疗设计中的应用，其中涉及基于染色质可及性数据设计细胞类型特异性调控元件，与染色质水平调控建模相关但非三维基因组空间架构建模。
documents.abstract: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: This review surveys recent advances in artificial intelligence-guided small molecule discovery and gene therapy, with a focus on generative and foundation models, and their translational applications to ophthalmic therapeutics. RECENT FINDINGS: A unifying theme across recent work is the shift from artificial intelligence as a screening tool to artificial intelligence as an engine for generative design. In small molecule discovery, reinforcement learning and diffusion-based generative models are producing structurally novel candidates for ophthalmic indications with demonstrated preclinical efficacy, while structure-based approaches leveraging AlphaFold and co-folding models are improving target identification and virtual screening. In gene therapy, artificial intelligence-guided AAV capsid engineering has yielded vectors with improved retinal transduction efficiency in nonhuman primates. Complementing this, deep learning models trained on chromatin accessibility data are enabling de novo design of compact, cell-type-specific regulatory elements, with direct implications for the specificity and payload capacity of ocular gene therapy vectors. Artificial intelligence-guided CRISPR guide RNA optimization is further expanding the precision of gene editing-based approaches. SUMMARY: Artificial intelligence tools may influence the landscape of ophthalmic drug discovery, from nominating small molecule candidates to co-designing next-generation gene therapy vectors. Rigorous experimental validation remains essential; artificial intelligence-nominated candidates and predictions must be tested empirically to confirm their safety, biological relevance, and therapeutic efficacy. 综述目的：本综述调查了人工智能引导的小分子发现和基因治疗的最新进展，重点关注生成模型和基础模型及其在眼科治疗中的转化应用。近期发现：近期工作的一个统一主题是人工智能从筛选工具向生成设计引擎的转变。在小分子发现中，强化学习和基于扩散的生成模型正在为眼科适应症产生结构新颖的候选分子，并已显示出临床前疗效，而利用AlphaFold和共折叠模型的结构导向方法正在改进靶点识别和虚拟筛选。在基因治疗中，人工智能引导的AAV衣壳工程已产生在非人灵长类动物中具有改善视网膜转导效率的载体。与此相辅相成的是，基于染色质可及性数据训练的深度学习模型能够从头设计紧凑的、细胞类型特异性的调控元件，这对眼科基因治疗载体的特异性和有效载荷能力具有直接影响。人工智能引导的CRISPR guide RNA优化进一步扩展了基于基因编辑方法的精确性。总结：人工智能工具可能影响眼科药物发现的格局，从提名小分子候选物到共同设计下一代基因治疗载体。严格的实验验证仍然至关重要；人工智能提名的候选物和预测必须通过经验测试来确认其安全性、生物学相关性和治疗功效。

documents.title: From metabolites to membrane vesicles: Unifying gut microbial signals in obesity, t2dm, and MASLD.
meta: Muttiah, Barathan; Venkatraman, Gopinath; Abdul-Rahman, Puteri Shafinaz
documents.summary: 综述肠道菌群代谢物在肥胖、T2DM和MASLD中的作用机制，涉及染色质结构重塑但无三维基因组/染色质组织建模，且无AI或分子模拟方法，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: Obesity, Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) represent interconnected global health problems that can be caused by dietary factors, life-style changes and alterations in the gut microbiota composition. While numerous reports highlight the connections between microbial taxa and the host diseases, the underlying molecular mechanisms behind the impact of metabolites on the disease development remain poorly defined. In this review, the connection between four interrelated pathways through which metabolites from the gut microbiota affect metabolic disease are highlighted. They include (i) reprogramming of host metabolism through histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibition and remodeling of the chromatin structure; (ii) mitochondrial dysfunction and disturbance in redox balance; (iii) hijacking of receptors and pathway biased crosstalk (FFAR2/3, GPR109A, FXR, TGR5, AhR, TLR4) and (iv) disruption of intestinal barrier and induction of metabolic endotoxemia. Such axes form a feedback network through which the inflammation and insulin resistance spread over the entire gut-adipose-liver-pancreas-muscle axis. The effect of the metabolites is very context-dependent since it relies on the concentration threshold, receptor bias, disease state and interaction between the host genotype and enterotype. The translational applications include composite metabolite biomarkers, enterotype-based therapeutic approaches, bacterial extracellular vesicles and machine learning approaches to develop multi-omics data analysis resulting in generation of a digital twin model. 肥胖、2型糖尿病（T2DM）和代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）构成了相互关联的全球性健康问题，这些问题可能由饮食因素、生活方式改变及肠道微生物群组成变化引起。尽管大量报告强调了微生物分类群与宿主疾病之间的联系，但代谢物影响疾病发展背后的潜在分子机制仍不明确。本综述重点阐述了肠道微生物群代谢物影响代谢疾病的四条相互关联通路之间的联系，包括：（i）通过组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制和染色质结构重塑实现宿主代谢重编程；（ii）线粒体功能障碍及氧化还原平衡紊乱；（iii）受体劫持及通路偏向性串扰（FFAR2/3、GPR109A、FXR、TGR5、AhR、TLR4）；以及（iv）肠道屏障破坏和代谢性内毒素血症诱导。这些轴形成反馈网络，炎症和胰岛素抵抗通过该网络扩散至整个肠-脂肪-肝-胰-肌轴。代谢物的效应高度依赖情境，因其取决于浓度阈值、受体偏向性、疾病状态以及宿主基因型与肠型之间的相互作用。转化应用包括复合代谢物生物标志物、基于肠型的治疗方法、细菌胞外囊泡以及机器学习方法，用于开发多组学数据分析，从而生成数字孪生模型。

documents.title: Methylome profiling of SetDB1-deficient ESCs reveals coordinated epigenetic cross-talk during pluripotency.
meta: Bovee, Nick G P; Habibi, Ehsan; Liu, Zicong; Hoogland, Stefan H A; Frolich, Siebren; Diepenbroek, Danielle; Bosman, Kim C M; Arand, Julia; Maksakova, Irina A; Kranenbarg, Anouk Klein; Walter, Jorn; Brinkman, Arie B; Mulder, Klaas W; Jansen, Joop H; Vermeulen, Michiel; Lorincz, Matthew; Stunnenberg, Hendrik G; Marks, Hendrik
documents.summary: 该文研究SetDB1敲除后DNA甲基化与组蛋白修饰的互作，虽涉及CTCF结合和表观遗传调控，但核心是甲基化谱而非染色质三维空间架构建模，且无AI或分子模拟方法贡献。
documents.abstract: SetDB1 is best known for catalyzing H3K9me3, but it also influences H3K27me3 deposition, CTCF-binding, and DNA methylation (DNAme). Given the interplay between DNAme and the other epigenetic features, we profiled DNAme following Setdb1 knockout (KO) in ground-state and serum-grown mouse embryonic stem cells (ESCs) to illuminate DNAme-dependent and -independent functions of SetDB1. Time-course whole-genome bisulfite sequencing of serum-grown ESCs shows that nearly half of SetDB1 binding sites are enriched with DNAme and H3K9me3, primarily at retrotransposons. Upon Setdb1 KO, both H3K9me3 and DNAme are reduced, with DNAme rapidly removed at many sites by TET enzymes. Some retrotransposons, primarily IAPs, are TET-resistant and lose DNAme slowly via passive dilution. Notably, SetDB1-mediated regulation of H3K27me3, CTCF-binding, and SMAD3 are uncoupled from the DNAme-H3K9me3 axis, and from each other. AlphaFold modeling and co-immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry suggest this uncoupling involves competitive binding to distinct SetDB1 protein domains, highlighting the complex coordination underlying SetDB1 functions. SetDB1最著名的是催化H3K9me3，但它也影响H3K27me3的沉积、CTCF结合和DNA甲基化（DNAme）。鉴于DNAme与其他表观遗传特征之间的相互作用，我们在基础状态和血清培养的小鼠胚胎干细胞（ESCs）中对Setdb1敲除（KO）后的DNAme进行了分析，以阐明SetDB1的DNAme依赖性和非依赖性功能。对血清培养ESCs进行的时间序列全基因组亚硫酸盐测序显示，近一半的SetDB1结合位点富含DNAme和H3K9me3，主要位于反转录转座子区域。Setdb1 KO后，H3K9me3和DNAme均减少，其中DNAme在许多位点被TET酶快速去除。一些反转录转座子，主要是IAPs，对TET具有抗性，并通过被动稀释缓慢丢失DNAme。值得注意的是，SetDB1介导的H3K27me3、CTCF结合和SMAD3的调控与DNAme-H3K9me3轴以及彼此之间是解耦的。AlphaFold建模和免疫共沉淀质谱分析表明，这种解耦涉及与SetDB1不同蛋白结构域的竞争性结合，突显了SetDB1功能背后复杂的协调机制。

documents.title: Dose-finding, experimental medicine evaluation of sodium valproate for the prevention of post-cardiac surgery myocardial injury
meta: Roman M; Beasley N; Ladak S; Solomon C; Laio W; Lai FY; Joel-David L; Aujla H; Condorelli G; Woźniak MJ; Codd V; Webb T; Brookes C; Mulla H; McCann GP; Murphy GJ
documents.summary: 该文为丙戊酸钠预防心脏手术后心肌损伤的剂量探索临床试验，涉及染色质可及性测序但未聚焦三维基因组/染色质组织建模，且无AI或分子模拟方法，与课题无关。
documents.abstract:
Background

A dose-finding trial evaluated safety and adherence for pre-cardiac surgery administration of sodium valproate. Integrated multi-omics analyses of myocardium were used to characterise mechanisms underlying treatment effects.

Methods

Adults undergoing cardiac surgery were randomised 1:1:1:1 with concealed allocation to no treatment (Controls), sodium valproate 15mg/kg/day for 1-2 weeks, 15mg/kg/day for 4-6 weeks, or 25mg/kg/day for 4-6 weeks pre-surgery. The primary analysis evaluated adherence and toxicity. Myocardial injury was defined by high sensitivity serum troponin at 24 hours post-surgery. Single-nucleus Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin with sequencing (snATACseq) and single nuclei RNA sequencing (snRNAseq) of myocardial biopsies collected at surgery assessed treatment effects on chromatin accessibility and gene expression. Candidate mechanisms were validated in in vitro .

Results

The analysis cohort included 42 participants enrolled between January 2020 and August 2024. Sodium valproate 15mg/kg/day for 1-2 weeks had the highest levels of complete treatment adherence (70%), with 20% experiencing moderate/severe drug related adverse effects. Non-compliance was increased with longer and higher dosing. An as-treated analyses demonstrated reductions in troponin release in participants receiving Valproate≤14 days where myocardial biopsies demonstrated activation of hormetic p53 and Akt-GSK-3β ferroptosis protection pathways versus controls. Silencing of these pathways attenuated the protective effect of valproate in vitro . Treatment effects were not attributable to chromatin accessibility. Treatment >14 days resulted in a heart failure phenotype, suppression of ferroptosis protection pathways, and increased myocardial injury.

Conclusions

Valproate 15mg/kg/day for ≤14 days pre-surgery is well tolerated in adults awaiting cardiac surgery and is associated with upregulation of ferroptosis protection pathways and reductions in myocardial injury.

背景

一项剂量探索试验评估了心脏手术前给予丙戊酸钠的安全性与依从性。通过心肌组织的整合多组学分析，表征了治疗效应背后的机制。

方法

接受心脏手术的成人受试者以1:1:1:1的比例随机分配至隐蔽分组：术前不接受治疗（对照组）、术前1-2周给予丙戊酸钠15mg/kg/天、术前4-6周给予15mg/kg/天、或术前4-6周给予25mg/kg/天。主要分析评估了依从性与毒性。心肌损伤定义为术后24小时高敏血清肌钙蛋白水平。通过手术时采集的心肌活检样本进行单核转座酶可及染色质测序（snATACseq）和单核RNA测序（snRNAseq），评估治疗对染色质可及性与基因表达的影响。候选机制在体外实验中得到验证。

结果

分析队列包括2020年1月至2024年8月期间入组的42名受试者。丙戊酸钠15mg/kg/天治疗1-2周组具有最高的完全治疗依从性（70%），其中20%出现中度/重度药物相关不良反应。延长治疗时间或增加剂量均导致不依从性增加。按实际治疗分析显示，接受丙戊酸钠≤14天的受试者肌钙蛋白释放减少，其心肌活检相较于对照组表现出毒物兴奋效应p53与Akt-GSK-3β铁死亡保护通路的激活。在体外实验中，沉默这些通路减弱了丙戊酸钠的保护效应。治疗效应与染色质可及性无关。治疗>14天导致心力衰竭表型、铁死亡保护通路抑制及心肌损伤增加。

结论

术前给予丙戊酸钠15mg/kg/天≤14天在等待心脏手术的成人中耐受性良好，并与铁死亡保护通路上调及心肌损伤减少相关。

documents.title: Distilling the Knowledge of Ensembles for Uncertainty-Aware Genomic Deep Learning.
meta: Zhou, Jessica; Rizzo, Kaeli; Christensen, Trevor; Tang, Ziqi; Koo, Peter K
documents.summary: 该文提出DEGU框架，通过集成学习和知识蒸馏提升基因组深度学习模型的鲁棒性与不确定性估计，但对象为通用调控基因组预测，未涉及染色质三维结构或空间组织建模，方法虽为AI但缺乏与三维基因组/染色质折叠的直接关联。
documents.abstract: While deep neural networks have revolutionized predictive modeling in regulatory genomics, challenges persist in ensuring the reliability of their predictions and understanding model decision-making processes. This chapter introduces DEGU (Distilling Ensembles for Genomic Uncertainty-aware models), a model-training framework that integrates ensemble learning with knowledge distillation to enhance the robustness and explainability of genomic deep learning predictions. DEGU distills the distribution of predictions from an ensemble of models into a single student model, capturing both the ensemble's average predictions and the variability across models, which represents epistemic uncertainty. Additionally, DEGU can estimate aleatoric uncertainty by modeling variability across experimental replicates. Through applications across diverse functional genomic prediction tasks, we demonstrate that DEGU-trained models achieve ensemble-level performance in a single model, exhibit improved generalization to out-of-distribution sequences, provide more consistent mechanistic explanations through attribution analysis, and generate calibrated uncertainty estimates. These advances position DEGU as a practical framework for developing trustworthy and robust deep learning applications in genomics research. 尽管深度神经网络在调控基因组学中的预测建模领域引发了革命性变革，但在确保预测可靠性及理解模型决策过程方面仍存在挑战。本章介绍DEGU（Distilling Ensembles for Genomic Uncertainty-aware models，面向基因组不确定性感知模型的集成蒸馏框架），该模型训练框架将集成学习与知识蒸馏相结合，以增强基因组深度学习预测的鲁棒性与可解释性。DEGU将集成模型集合的预测分布蒸馏至单一学生模型，同时捕获集成模型的平均预测值及模型间的变异性（即认知不确定性）。此外，DEGU可通过建模实验重复间的变异性来估计偶然不确定性。通过在不同功能基因组预测任务中的应用，我们证明经DEGU训练的模型能以单一模型实现集成级性能，对分布外序列展现出更优的泛化能力，通过归因分析提供更一致的机制解释，并生成经过校准的不确定性估计。这些进展使DEGU成为基因组学研究中开发可信赖且鲁棒深度学习应用的实用框架。

documents.title: AI-Based 3D Heterogeneous Network Model for Functional Prediction of Epigenetics.
documents.summary: 该文提出基于AI的多模态数据整合三维异质网络模型用于表观遗传功能预测，虽涉及染色质结构调控但未聚焦三维基因组/染色质组织建模，方法上AI建模有启发但对象和结构/调控轴偏弱。
documents.abstract: Human biology and diseases are the result of constantly evolving processes within an intricately complex molecular network of interactions, such as epigenetic regulation. Epigenetics refers to heritable changes in gene expression that occur without alterations to the underlying DNA sequence. These changes, driven by mechanisms such as DNA methylation, histone modifications, and noncoding RNAs, play critical roles in regulating chromatin structure and gene activity. Epigenetic regulation offers valuable insights into biological systems, and when integrated with sophisticated analyses, it enables us to gain insights into gene regulation and cellular behavior. Here, we describe an artificial intelligence (AI)-based model that is capable of generating 3-dimensional (3D) heterogeneous network by integrating multimodal data for the functional prediction of epigenetic mechanisms, emphasizing its applications in medicine, developmental biology, and personalized therapeutics. Heterogeneous networks in biology are powerful tools for understanding the complex interactions and interdependencies within biological systems. Key advancements in AI and multiomics data integration have propelled this field, offering new insights into disease mechanisms, biomarker discovery, and therapeutic interventions. 人类生物学与疾病是复杂精密的分子相互作用网络（如表观遗传调控）中持续演化过程的结果。表观遗传学（Epigenetics）指不涉及DNA序列改变的可遗传基因表达变化。这些变化由DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）、组蛋白修饰（histone modifications）及非编码RNA（noncoding RNAs）等机制驱动，在调控染色质结构与基因活性中发挥关键作用。表观遗传调控为理解生物系统提供了重要视角，当与精密分析相结合时，能使我们深入理解基因调控与细胞行为。本文描述了一种基于人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）的模型，该模型通过整合多模态数据生成三维（3-dimensional, 3D）异质网络（heterogeneous network），用于表观遗传机制的功能预测，重点阐述其在医学、发育生物学及个性化治疗中的应用。生物学中的异质网络是理解生物系统内复杂相互作用与相互依赖关系的强大工具。人工智能与多组学数据整合（multiomics data integration）的关键进展推动了该领域发展，为疾病机制、生物标志物发现及治疗干预提供了新见解。

documents.title: Leveraging human-trained neural networks for cross-species chromatin regulation annotations.
meta: Maillard, Noemien; Demars, Julie; Mourad, Raphael
documents.summary: 该文利用人类训练的神经网络跨物种预测染色质调控注释（如转录因子结合、组蛋白修饰），但主要关注序列层面的调控注释，未涉及三维基因组或染色质空间架构的建模，与课题核心方向关联较弱。
documents.abstract: Analogous to the Encyclopedia of DNA Elements (ENCODE) project, the Functional Annotation of ANimal Genomes (FAANG) consortium has produced chromatin annotations for domesticated animals, albeit in smaller amounts. Although acquiring experimental data is more accessible and affordable for many species, human and mouse organisms will remain the reference. Classical methods based on sequence conservation can be used to infer missing annotations, but are inappropriate for non-conserved sequences. While regulatory sequences share low to moderate conservation, they have retained their regulatory function during the evolution process. Here, we take advantage of three neural networks (DeepBind, DeepSEA, and Enformer) trained with human and mouse ENCODE data to infer chromatin annotations (transcription factors binding, chromatin accessibility, and histone marks) in cattle, pig, chicken, and European seabass. For this purpose, we comprehensively assessed the quality of predictions using experimental data from FAANG, through AUC-ROC and AUC-PR metrics. Our results showed low variability between tissues and similar performances for various annotations in mammals and chicken, with AUC-PR ranging from 0.663 +/- 0.010 (chicken) to 0.765 +/- 0.009 (pig) for the best predicted experiment, H3K4me3 (all tissues grouped), but lower (0.238 +/- 0.005) in fish. Further analyses focused on pigs highlighted (i) accurate predictions even for non-conserved sequences, and (ii) variable predictions depending on genomic feature annotations. Our results advocate the widespread use of human-trained neural networks as a first step in cross-species genome annotation before training species-specific models. 类似于DNA元件百科全书（ENCODE）项目，动物基因组功能注释（FAANG）联盟已为家养动物生成了染色质注释，尽管数量较少。尽管对于许多物种而言，获取实验数据更为便捷和经济，但人类和小鼠生物体仍将作为参考。基于序列保守性的经典方法可用于推断缺失的注释，但不适用于非保守序列。虽然调控序列的保守性从低到中等，但它们在进化过程中保留了调控功能。在此，我们利用三个基于人类和小鼠ENCODE数据训练的神经网络（DeepBind、DeepSEA和Enformer），来推断牛、猪、鸡和欧洲海鲈的染色质注释（转录因子结合、染色质可及性和组蛋白修饰）。为此，我们通过AUC-ROC和AUC-PR指标，使用FAANG的实验数据全面评估了预测质量。我们的结果显示，哺乳动物和鸡的不同组织间变异性较低，且各种注释的性能相似，最佳预测实验H3K4me3（所有组织合并）的AUC-PR范围从0.663 +/- 0.010（鸡）到0.765 +/- 0.009（猪），但在鱼类中较低（0.238 +/- 0.005）。进一步针对猪的分析强调了：（i）即使对于非保守序列也能准确预测，以及（ii）预测结果因基因组特征注释而异。我们的结果支持广泛使用人类训练的神经网络，作为跨物种基因组注释的第一步，之后再训练物种特异性模型。

documents.title: Dynamical Regimes in Rejuvenation
documents.summary: 该文通过场论和分子动力学模拟研究表观遗传修饰与染色质三维构象的耦合动力学，揭示重编程中染色质组织介导的表观遗传可逆重塑机制，直接契合染色质空间架构的计算建模与调控机理。
documents.abstract: Biological aging is accompanied by systematic changes in epigenetic modifications and chromatin organization. The reversal of the effects of aging, rejuvenation, is experimentally achieved by the transient induction of factors that modify these marks in cells and organisms. Here, we show that key features of rejuvenation experiments emerge from the biophysical interplay between dynamic epigenetic marks and the three-dimensional conformation of chromatin. Using a minimal field theory and molecular dynamics simulations, we show that the system responds in three distinct temporal regimes. The intermediary regime fulfills necessary conditions for successful rejuvenation. In this regime, the system spends time near a separatrix, allowing for high epigenetic plasticity, while memory retained in the chromatin conformation enables restoration of the original epigenetic correlations. Analysis of sequencing data further supports the predicted coupling between chromatin compaction and epigenetic correlations. Our results provide a physical explanation for how rejuvenation may remodel age-associated epigenetic states without irreversibly erasing cellular identity. We identify a general mechanism by which memory stored in a slow structural variable permits reversible remodeling of a faster internal state. 生物衰老伴随着表观遗传修饰和染色质组织的系统性变化。通过短暂诱导细胞和生物体中修饰这些标记的因子，可在实验上实现衰老效应的逆转，即年轻化（rejuvenation）。在此，我们展示年轻化实验的关键特征源于动态表观遗传标记与染色质三维构象之间的生物物理相互作用。利用最小场论（minimal field theory）和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，我们证明系统在三个不同的时间尺度上响应。中间尺度满足成功年轻化的必要条件。在此尺度下，系统在分界线（separatrix）附近停留，从而实现高表观遗传可塑性，同时染色质构象中保留的记忆能够恢复原始表观遗传相关性。测序数据的分析进一步支持了所预测的染色质压缩与表观遗传相关性之间的耦合。我们的结果为年轻化如何重塑与衰老相关的表观遗传状态而不不可逆地抹除细胞身份提供了物理解释。我们识别出一种通用机制，即存储在慢速结构变量中的记忆允许对较快内部状态进行可逆重塑。

documents.title: mmVelo: A deep generative model for estimating cell state-dependent dynamics across multiple modalities.
meta: Nomura, Satoshi; Kojima, Yasuhiro; Minoura, Kodai; Hayashi, Shuto; Abe, Ko; Hirose, Haruka; Shimamura, Teppei
documents.summary: 该文提出深度生成模型mmVelo，利用多组学数据推断染色质可及性动态（染色质速度），虽涉及染色质调控但未聚焦三维空间架构建模，方法可迁移至染色质动态预测。
documents.abstract: MOTIVATION: Single-cell multiomics reveals regulatory relationships across biological layers but captures only static snapshots, obscuring the dynamics coordinated across modalities. RNA velocity predicts transcriptome dynamics, yet cannot be extended to other layers such as the regulome, leaving chromatin accessibility dynamics unresolved. RESULTS: We developed mmVelo, a deep generative model that infers cell state dynamics from spliced and unspliced mRNA and projects them onto other modalities, yielding chromatin velocity at single-peak resolution. In developing mouse brain, mmVelo accurately recovered accessibility dynamics; in mouse skin, it identified transcription factors regulating accessibility. Decomposing posterior velocity variability into manifold-aligned and off-manifold components revealed modality-specific uncertainty structure, with chromatin fluctuation elevated near lineage branching. Using multiomics data as a bridge, mmVelo inferred the dynamics of missing modalities from single-modal human brain data. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Source code is freely available under the MIT license at https://github.com/nomuhyooon/mmVelo; the version and test data used here are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20103609. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online. 动机：单细胞多组学技术揭示了跨生物学层次的调控关系，但仅捕获静态快照，掩盖了跨模态协调的动态过程。RNA速度预测转录组动态，但无法扩展到其他层次（如调控组），导致染色质可及性动态仍未解决。结果：我们开发了mmVelo，一种深度生成模型，从剪接和未剪接mRNA推断细胞状态动态，并将其投射到其他模态，实现单峰分辨率的染色质速度。在小鼠发育大脑中，mmVelo准确恢复了可及性动态；在小鼠皮肤中，它识别了调控可及性的转录因子。将后验速度变异性分解为流形对齐和流形外成分，揭示了模态特异性不确定性结构，其中染色质波动在谱系分支附近升高。利用多组学数据作为桥梁，mmVelo从单模态人类大脑数据推断缺失模态的动态。可用性和实现：源代码在MIT许可下免费提供，网址为https://github.com/nomuhyooon/mmVelo；本文使用的版本和测试数据存档于https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20103609。补充信息：补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。

documents.title: Ribo-ITP enables identification of translons from limited input samples.

documents.summary: 该文开发Ribo-ITP方法从低输入样本中鉴定翻译区域（translons），虽涉及机器学习预测，但对象为翻译调控而非三维基因组/染色质组织，且无染色质空间架构建模或分子模拟，与本课题关联极低。
documents.abstract: In the last decade, an unexpectedly large number of translated regions (translons) have been discovered using ribosome profiling and proteomics. Translons can act as regulatory elements or encode functional micropeptides. However, identification of translons has been limited to cell lines or large organs due to high input requirements for conventional ribosome profiling and mass spectrometry. Here, we address this input limitation using Ribo-ITP on difficult-to-collect samples such as microdissected hippocampal tissues and single preimplantation embryos to identify thousands of translons. To test the translational capacity of the identified translons, we engineer a translon-dependent GFP reporter system and detect expression of translons initiating at ATG and near-cognate start codons in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs). We identify distinct expression patterns of translons using a comparative analysis of more than a thousand ribosome profiling datasets across a wide range of cell types. Further, using a machine learning model, we predict that specific upstream translons in synaptically enriched mRNAs regulate translation efficiency of the annotated coding region. Taken together, we present a proof-of-concept study to identify non-canonical translation events from low input samples which can be applied to cell and tissue types inaccessible to conventional methods. 在过去十年中，通过核糖体图谱分析（ribosome profiling）和蛋白质组学（proteomics）发现了数量出乎意料庞大的翻译区域（translons）。Translons可以作为调控元件或编码功能性微肽。然而，由于传统核糖体图谱分析和质谱法对输入量要求较高，translons的鉴定一直局限于细胞系或大型器官。在此，我们通过使用Ribo-ITP技术，针对难以采集的样本（如显微切割的海马组织和单个植入前胚胎）解决了这一输入量限制，鉴定出数千个translons。为测试所鉴定translons的翻译能力，我们构建了一个依赖于translon的GFP报告系统，并检测了小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESCs）中起始于ATG和近同源起始密码子的translons表达。通过对超过一千个跨多种细胞类型的核糖体图谱分析数据集进行比较分析，我们识别出translons的不同表达模式。此外，利用机器学习模型，我们预测突触富集mRNA中的特定上游translons调节注释编码区的翻译效率。综合来看，我们提出了一项概念验证研究，用于从低输入样本中识别非经典翻译事件，该方法可应用于传统方法无法触及的细胞和组织类型。

documents.title: Unraveling the Molecular Basis of NSD3 Allosteric Activation Driven by Nucleosome Binding: A Multiscale MD and QM/MM Approach.
meta: Blanco-Esperguez, Kevin; Gutierrez-Sanchez, Nestor; Mendizabal, Fernando; Miranda-Rojas, Sebastian
Journal of chemical information and modeling
documents.summary: 该文通过多尺度MD和QM/MM模拟研究核小体结合对NSD3甲基转移酶的变构激活机制，虽涉及染色质相关蛋白（核小体）和分子模拟方法，但核心对象是酶催化机制而非三维基因组/染色质高级结构组织，与课题方向关联较弱。
documents.abstract: Nuclear receptor-binding SET domain 3 (NSD3) is a methyltransferase responsible for mono- and di-methylation of histone H3 lysine 36, whose hyperactivation is linked to accelerated cancer cell proliferation. Isolated NSD3 is autoinhibited due to a conformation that prevents substrate binding, but nucleosome binding allosterically activates the enzyme. Using a cryo-EM structure of nucleosome-bound NSD3, we combined molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and QM/MM calculations to explore the activation mechanism at the molecular level. QM/MM models accurately reproduced experimental observations, showing that nucleosome binding decreases the reaction barrier for the first methylation from 19.1 +/- 4.4 kcal/mol (isolated enzyme) to 4.7 +/- 1.6 kcal/mol (nucleosome-bound), validating the models. Key catalytic site residues and conformational restrictions involved in activation were identified. The Activation Strain Model-Energy Decomposition Analysis (ASM-EDA) approach revealed the physical forces underlying energy barrier differences between active and isolated states. MD simulations highlighted structural stabilization into specific conformations, and dynamical network analysis mapped interaction pathways connecting the nucleosome interface to the catalytic machinery, elucidating the allosteric control mechanism. The second methylation showed similar mechanistic insights. These findings provide a molecular-level understanding of nucleosome-mediated allosteric regulation in NSD3 and related methyltransferases, offering potential targets for the structure-based design of allosteric inhibitors. 核受体结合SET结构域3（NSD3）是一种负责组蛋白H3第36位赖氨酸单甲基化和二甲基化的甲基转移酶，其过度活化与癌细胞加速增殖相关。分离的NSD3因构象阻止底物结合而处于自抑制状态，但核小体结合可别构激活该酶。利用核小体结合NSD3的冷冻电镜结构，我们结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和QM/MM计算，在分子水平上探究其激活机制。QM/MM模型准确再现了实验观察结果，显示核小体结合将第一次甲基化的反应能垒从19.1 +/- 4.4 kcal/mol（分离酶）降低至4.7 +/- 1.6 kcal/mol（核小体结合态），验证了模型的可靠性。研究鉴定了参与激活的关键催化位点残基和构象限制因素。通过激活应变模型-能量分解分析（Activation Strain Model-Energy Decomposition Analysis, ASM-EDA）方法，揭示了活性态与分离态之间能垒差异背后的物理作用力。MD模拟强调了结构稳定化为特定构象的过程，而动力学网络分析则绘制了连接核小体界面与催化机制的相互作用通路，阐明了别构控制机制。第二次甲基化显示出类似的机制特征。这些发现提供了对NSD3及相关甲基转移酶中核小体介导的别构调控的分子层面理解，为基于结构的别构抑制剂设计提供了潜在靶点。
